metadata.label: Replay: Pear Lake wildfire (2026-C40983, 2026)

referenceEvents.event: SLRD evacuation order for properties in the Pear Lake area
Reception centre for evacuees set up in Kamloops (McArthur Island Sport and Events Centre)
Clinton evacuation order downgraded to an alert
TNRD gives the all clear to nearly 1,243 properties

assumptions: Size, stage of control and location are CWFIS agency-reported values at the reported times.
Sizes between reports are linearly interpolated every 12 h (isReported = false).
Reported size is made non-decreasing; small downward revisions are smoothed out.
Fire extent is a circle with the reported area around the reported point, not a mapped perimeter.
Weather alerts are not replayed (no ECCC archive); other fires active at the time are not included.
Scores use the same rules as wildfire_pipeline.py.
